# Panoptic

> Panoptic is a permissionless protocol for perpetual options and lending built on concentrated liquidity. Panoptic v2 supports options on Uniswap v3 and v4 pools, with streaming premia, collateral vaults, and a dedicated risk engine.

This protocol and developer documentation index prioritizes Panoptic v2. Uniswap v3/v4 names the underlying AMM, not the Panoptic version; do not use v1/v1.1 interfaces for v2. Contract references describe their pinned source revision; deployed behavior depends on the pool's RiskEngine and chain- and block-specific configuration. “Oracle-free” pricing does not mean v2 lacks internal risk oracles.

## Getting started

- [Introduction](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/intro.md): Protocol purpose and perpetual options basics.
- [Options traders](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/getting-started/options-traders.md): Trading workflow and links to product guides.
- [Lenders](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/getting-started/passive-lp.md): Passive liquidity provision and lending markets.
- [Borrowers](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/getting-started/borrowers.md): Borrowing workflow, collateral, and interest.
- [Vaults](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/getting-started/vaults.md): Managed vault strategies, deposits, and withdrawals.

## Protocol mechanics, options, and LP positions

- [Protocol design](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/panoptic-protocol/design.md): Relationship between concentrated liquidity and perpetual options.
- [Streamia](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/product/streamia.md): Streaming option premia, payment flows, and accumulation.
- [Option legs](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/product/option-legs.md): Combining legs into option strategies.
- [Provide liquidity](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/product/uniswap-lps/provide-liquidity.md): Product walkthrough for Uniswap LP positions through Panoptic.
- [V2 position types](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/panoptic-protocol/V2/position-types.md): Options, zero-width loans and credits, and their collateral treatment.
- [V2 composite strategies](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/panoptic-protocol/V2/composite-strategies.md): Risk partners and collateral treatment of multi-leg positions.

## Costs and fees

- [V2 fees and builder routing](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/contracts/parameters.md#fees-and-builder-routing): Protocol commissions and builder fees, distinguished from streaming option premia and borrowing interest.

## Collateral and risk

- [V2 collateral overview](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/panoptic-protocol/V2/collateral-overview.md): Dual-token collateral accounting and solvency.
- [V2 oracle system](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/panoptic-protocol/V2/oracle-system.md): Internal price observations used for risk calculations.
- [V2 safe mode](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/panoptic-protocol/V2/safe-mode.md): Protective restrictions and collateral adjustments.
- [V2 interest accrual](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/panoptic-protocol/V2/interest-accrual.md): Borrow interest and its effect on collateral balances.
- [V2 dispatchFrom](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/panoptic-protocol/V2/dispatchfrom-entrypoint.md): Liquidation, forced exercise, and third-party premium settlement flows.
- [V2 parameters by RiskEngine](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/contracts/parameters.md): On-chain configuration snapshots, token ordering, and engine-specific collateral, oracle, and interest parameters.
- [Options trading risks](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/panoptic-protocol/risks.md): Protocol and trading risks, with applicability labels for different instruments.

## Contract architecture and developer integration

- [Developer overview](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/developers/overview.md): SDK capabilities, integration status, and starting points for developers.
- [Read your first market](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/developers/v2-integration.md): Pinned SDK installation, a concrete Ethereum ETH/USDC pool example, expected output, and troubleshooting; no wallet or funds required.
- [Simulate your first position](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/developers/simulate-position.md): Read-only first-position simulation, expected unfunded rejection, funded fork verification, and collateral output interpretation.
- [Complete a trade lifecycle](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/developers/trade-lifecycle.md): Runnable local-fork funding, simulation, opening, account reconstruction, closing, and withdrawal with sandbox guards.
- [Core concepts](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/developers/core-concepts.md): Perpetual options, token denomination, position identity, collateral, costs, and closing.
- [Capabilities and support](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/developers/capabilities.md): Demonstrated SDK paths, integration responsibilities, and unverified or unavailable onboarding and mobile capabilities.
- [Developer troubleshooting](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/developers/troubleshooting.md): Dependency, RPC, account-state, and simulation failures and recovery steps.
- [How an integration works](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/developers/integration-workflow.md): Trading lifecycle, SDK and application responsibilities, RPC versus indexed data, transaction confirmation, and state freshness.

- [Smart contracts overview](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/contracts/smart-contracts-overview.md): Architecture and contract directory, with separate v2, v1.1, and v1 sections.
- [V2 PanopticPool](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/contracts/V2/contract.PanopticPool.md): Position management interfaces, including dispatch and dispatchFrom.
- [V2 CollateralTracker](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/contracts/V2/contract.CollateralTracker.md): Collateral shares, deposits, withdrawals, and accounting interfaces.
- [V2 RiskEngine](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/contracts/V2/RiskEngine/contract.RiskEngine.md): Risk, solvency, oracle, and interest calculation reference.
- [V2 stock RiskEngine](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/contracts/V2/RiskEngine/contract.RiskEngineXStocks.md): Stock risk-policy source reference; constructor buffers distinguish normal and inverted deployments.
- [Public core source](https://github.com/panoptic-labs/panoptic-v2-core): Public contract repository; documentation source links pin specific revisions.
- [V2 dispatch guide](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/panoptic-protocol/V2/dispatch-entrypoint.md): Inputs and flows for minting, burning, and premium settlement.
- [V2 TokenIdLibrary](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/contracts/V2/types/library.TokenIdLibrary.md): Encoding and decoding position legs in a token ID.
- [V2 factory for Uniswap v3](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/contracts/V2/contract.PanopticFactory.md): Pool deployment and lookup interfaces for the v3 AMM.
- [V2 factory for Uniswap v4](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/contracts/V2/contract.PanopticFactoryV4.md): Pool deployment and lookup interfaces for the v4 AMM.

## Deployed addresses

- [Deployment addresses](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/contracts/deployment-addresses.md): Core and vault addresses grouped by protocol version and, for v2, chain; distinguishes shared implementations from pool proxies.

## Security

- [Security and audits](https://panoptic.xyz/docs/security/security_audits.md): Core protocol, oracle hook, economic, and vault reports; check each report's version and scope against the intended deployment.
